_comment: Keyword classifier over the Meta lead field 'what_type_of_equipment_are_you_after:'
(note the trailing colon in the Meta field name). Section 8.4 of the brief.
Roughly 19% of leads request equipment HireHospo does not finance. This classifier is a
live measure of whether the ad copy is filtering properly, so the out of catalogue list
is evaluated FIRST. Order matters: 'ice maker' must not be swept into 'refrigeration'
by a loose keyword, or the wasted spend measure quietly reports zero.
KNOWN CONFLICT, needs a decision. Section 8.4 lists ice makers as NOT financed, while
docs/BUSINESS_OVERVIEW.md lists a catalogue category called 'refrigeration & ice'. The
brief is treated as authoritative here and ice is classified out of catalogue, but this
is flagged rather than resolved silently. If ice makers are in fact financed, move the
'ice' entry from outOfCatalogue into the refrigeration category. No code change needed.

matching._comment: Matching is done on word boundaries so 'sink' does not match 'sinking' and 'range' does not match 'arrangement'. A lead matching more than one in catalogue category is counted once, under its first match, and its other matches are recorded.

outOfCatalogue._comment: Evaluated before the in catalogue list. Every one of these was observed in real lead data.
